description: Result of scripts/freeze_blur_test.py: spectral blur of a frozen (or sustained) vibrato vowel, adjacent-bin / peak-bin ratio per harmonic in dB (more negative = sharper). The static vowel is sharpest (mean -5.496 dB), the vibrato vowel blurriest (mean -1.392 dB), the simulated freeze between them (mean -4.357 dB). When no --max-blur-db threshold is given, pass is null and the result reports the value only.
title: ARC-AudioBench Freeze-Blur Test Result
